typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		SNo as decimal(18,0),
		{Site Location} as string,
		{Start Date} as date,
		{End Date} as date,
		{Cage Name} as string,
		UsableCapacityKW as float,
		{Source  (A)} as float,
		{Source  (B)} as float,
		{Total Cons(KW)} as float,
		{Total Cons(Kwh)} as float
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		CageName as string,
		SiteLocation as string,
		UsableCapacityKW as double,
		EndDate as string,
		FName as string,
		StartDate as string,
		TotalConsKwh as double,
		EtlUser as string,
		SourceB as double,
		SourceA as double,
		SNo as integer,
		TotalConsKW as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		CageName = {Cage Name},
		SiteLocation = {Site Location},
		UsableCapacityKW,
		EndDate = {End Date},
		FName,
		StartDate = {Start Date},
		TotalConsKwh = {Total Cons(Kwh)},
		EtlUser,
		SourceB = {Source  (B)},
		SourceA = {Source  (A)},
		SNo,
		TotalConsKW = {Total Cons(KW)}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
